_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

A Journey Further#001.src: Alright, let’s go. I’ll tell you more about our journey on the way.
A Journey Further#001.dst: 好，走吧。路上我再多跟你說說這趟任務的事。
A Journey Further#001.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#002.dst: 跟著 Aledar 繼續前進。

A Journey Further#003.src: We should try to follow the path as closely as we can. You lead, I'll follow.
A Journey Further#003.dst: 我們盡量沿著這條路走。你帶頭，我跟著。
A Journey Further#003.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#008.src: Good work. Seems that killing the king made the other creatures run off. We’re lucky about that-
A Journey Further#008.dst: 幹得好。看樣子首領一死，其他東西就跑光了。這算我們走運——
A Journey Further#008.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#009.src: Wait, {u}, what's going on? Are you alright?
A Journey Further#009.dst: 等等，{u}，怎麼回事？你還好嗎？
A Journey Further#009.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#010.src: Oh, no no! I have a potion for this, where is it, where is it, aha! Here, drink!
A Journey Further#010.dst: 噢，不不不！我有藥水可以治這個，放哪去了、放哪去了，啊哈！來，喝下去！
A Journey Further#010.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#011.src: One of those things must have infected your wounds... Everything in this area looks completely hazardous and sickening.
A Journey Further#011.dst: 一定是那些東西感染了你的傷口……這一帶的東西看起來全都又毒又髒。
A Journey Further#011.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#012.src: I expected the worst, so I tried to bring anything and everything that might help. Let's keep moving.
A Journey Further#012.dst: 我早就做了最壞的打算，所以能帶的東西我全帶上了。繼續走吧。
A Journey Further#012.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#013.src: Continue on the main path with Aledar.
A Journey Further#013.dst: 跟著 Aledar 沿主路前進。

A Journey Further#016.src: I'm... I'm going to lead us for now. At least for a little...while... I can't have you g-getting-
A Journey Further#016.dst: 我……我先帶路吧。至少撐一……一段路……我不能讓你再受——
A Journey Further#016.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#018.src: ...urgh... I...sorry. I just... I need a moment.
A Journey Further#018.dst: ……唔……我……抱歉。我只是……需要緩一下。
A Journey Further#018.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#019.src: {u}, you just... you have to realize, I can't have you getting hurt.
A Journey Further#019.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#020.src: I want to stress this... We NEED to get to the end of this path, together.
A Journey Further#020.dst: 我要把話講清楚……我們必須一起走到這條路的盡頭。
A Journey Further#020.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#022.src: Okay. I'm as good as I can get right now. Let's move.
A Journey Further#022.dst: 好了。我現在能好的就這樣了。走吧。
A Journey Further#022.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#023.src: Ah? What... What just... Why do I...
A Journey Further#023.dst: 啊？什麼……剛剛那是……我怎麼會……
A Journey Further#023.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#024.src: I'll be fine, I just...why did I feel so empty all of the sudden... ?
A Journey Further#024.dst: 我沒事，只是……為什麼突然覺得整個人空了一塊……？
A Journey Further#024.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#025.src: Oh no, I think something is coming... {u}! Fight it off, I don't think I can defend myself right now!
A Journey Further#025.dst: 糟了，好像有東西過來了……{u}！你擋一下，我現在連自己都護不住！
A Journey Further#025.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#026.src: Defend Aledar from the Radiated Spiders.
A Journey Further#026.dst: 保護 Aledar，擊退 Radiated Spider。

A Journey Further#027.src: Huff... Not feeling totally better, but... At least I can still defend myself.
A Journey Further#027.dst: 呼……還沒完全恢復，不過……至少我還能自保。
A Journey Further#027.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#028.src: My stomach is empty, I can't even vomit... Why so I still feel so dizzy? Maybe a potion will help...
A Journey Further#028.dst: 胃裡空空的，想吐都吐不出來……為什麼還是這麼暈？也許喝點藥水會好一些……
A Journey Further#028.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#030.src: Urgh, pfft! My vomit tasted better than that coming up...
A Journey Further#030.dst: 嘔，呸！這味道比我吐出來的還難喝……
A Journey Further#030.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#031.src: Hah...that's the ticket. Which potion was this anyways... ... hair loss treatment? Why did THAT work?
A Journey Further#031.dst: 哈……這瓶對了。話說回來這到底是什麼藥水……生髮水？這東西為什麼會有效？
A Journey Further#031.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#032.src: Though, you saw what happened to that beast I attacked? Follow me.
A Journey Further#032.dst: 對了，你剛剛看到我打飛的那隻怪物怎麼了嗎？跟我來。
A Journey Further#032.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#033.src: This, from what I recall of the mission statements, is referred to as a "Void Hole." It's a sort of portal.
A Journey Further#033.dst: 照我記得的任務簡報，這東西叫「Void Hole」，是一種傳送門。
A Journey Further#033.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#034.src: They connect to each other in odd ways, but we saw the beast come out of that one when I knocked it in, so...
A Journey Further#034.dst: 它們彼此之間連接的方式很怪，不過我把那隻怪物打進去之後，牠是從那一頭出來的，所以——
A Journey Further#034.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#035.src: Watch. I'll come out the other side.
A Journey Further#035.dst: 看好。我會從另一頭出來。
A Journey Further#035.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#036.src: Alright, good! It does connect up consistently, at least. You try now.
A Journey Further#036.dst: 好，很好！至少連接的位置是固定的。換你試試。
A Journey Further#036.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#038.src: Continue on the trail with Aledar.
A Journey Further#038.dst: 跟著 Aledar 沿小徑前進。

A Journey Further#039.src: I bring this up because if we're seeing one, we'll be seeing more soon. You'll need to adjust yourself to the sight of them.
A Journey Further#039.dst: 我會提這件事，是因為既然看到了一個，接下來一定還會看到更多。你得先習慣它們的樣子。
A Journey Further#039.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#041.src: We grossly underestimated the difficulties we would have here. And, by that, I mean myself, Elphie, and Lucio did...
A Journey Further#041.dst: 我們嚴重低估了這裡的難度。而且我說的「我們」，是指我、Elphie 和 Lucio……
A Journey Further#041.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#042.src: We were each unprepared and cocky. If it weren't for you, I'd be dead now, for what it's worth.
A Journey Further#042.dst: 我們每一個都準備不足又自以為是。要不是有你，我現在早就死了，這話我說得出口。
A Journey Further#042.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#043.src: I wasn't certain at first about you coming along, but you've more than shown you were the right one for the job.
A Journey Further#043.dst: 一開始我對你同行這件事沒什麼把握，但你已經證明得夠多了——這趟就該是你來。
A Journey Further#043.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#044.src: ...I had to figure this map was outdated. This wall of spikes isn't listed on it, and the path goes through here!
A Journey Further#044.dst: ……我早該想到這張地圖過時了。上面根本沒標這道尖刺牆，而路就是從這裡穿過去的！
A Journey Further#044.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#045.src: I'll have to assume they're new...and if they're new, I might be able to bash through them.
A Journey Further#045.dst: 只能當作是新長出來的……既然是新的，也許我能把它砸開。
A Journey Further#045.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#046.src: {u}, try throwing a spell at the same time! Let's crack through these things!
A Journey Further#046.dst: {u}，你同時丟一個法術過來！我們把這些東西轟破！
A Journey Further#046.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#048.src: ...aagh... I... H-how are these so resilient...?
A Journey Further#048.dst: ……啊啊……我……這、這些東西怎麼會這麼硬……？
A Journey Further#048.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#049.src: I'm an idiot... I nearly killed myself trying that. I nearly ruined the mission...
A Journey Further#049.dst: 我真是個白痴……剛剛差點把自己弄死。差點毀了整個任務……
A Journey Further#049.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#050.src: I'm sorry, but you'll have to go without me. I can't move another step for now.
A Journey Further#050.dst: 抱歉，接下來你得自己走了。我現在連一步都動不了。
A Journey Further#050.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#051.src: There's a lot of void holes around here, remember my warning... You can probably get past these spikes with one.
A Journey Further#051.dst: 這一帶有很多 Void Hole，記得我剛才說的……你大概可以靠它繞到尖刺後面。
A Journey Further#051.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#052.src: If I'd been thinking I would have suggested it earlier... Once you're past, we'll... uh. We'll do something.
A Journey Further#052.dst: 我要是早點想到就好了……等你過去之後，我們再……呃。再想辦法。
A Journey Further#052.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#053.src: Just...be careful where you go. The void holes could lead anywhere. They might lead you someplace very, very dangerous, too dangerous even for you. I pray they won't...
A Journey Further#053.dst: 只是……小心你要去的地方。Void Hole 可能通往任何地方，也可能把你送到非常、非常危險的地方，危險到連你都應付不來。我只能祈禱不會……
A Journey Further#053.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#054.src: There's a void hole right there to try out first. Get going, now. You have to do this.
A Journey Further#054.dst: 那邊就有一個 Void Hole，先拿它試試。快去吧。這件事非你不可。
A Journey Further#054.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#055.src: Use Void Holes to try and get behind the spike barrier
A Journey Further#055.dst: 利用 Void Hole 設法繞到尖刺屏障後方

A Journey Further#056.src: Find a way to help Aledar get to the other side of the spike barrier.
A Journey Further#056.dst: 想辦法幫 Aledar 到尖刺屏障的另一邊。

A Journey Further#057.src: ...wait, {u}? You got to the other side then...? Good...
A Journey Further#057.dst: ……等等，{u}？你已經到另一邊了……？太好了……
A Journey Further#057.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#058.src: I don't know what you did, but whatever it was, it's made cracks in the spikes that I can see from this side.
A Journey Further#058.dst: 我不知道你做了什麼，但不管是什麼，尖刺上出現的裂痕從這一側都看得見。
A Journey Further#058.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#059.src: I've got some of my energy back...let's try spellcasting again. If we do it at the same time, we might make some headway.
A Journey Further#059.dst: 我恢復了一點力氣……再試一次法術吧。如果我們同時施法，也許能打開一個缺口。
A Journey Further#059.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#060.src: I won't crack my skull open on the spikes again though. Promise.
A Journey Further#060.dst: 這次我不會再拿頭去撞尖刺了。我保證。
A Journey Further#060.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#061.src: You lead. I'll cast my spell as soon as I hear yours.
A Journey Further#061.dst: 你先動手。我一聽到你的法術就跟上。
A Journey Further#061.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#062.src: Thank god it worked... That's our destination there, the Eldritch Outlook.
A Journey Further#062.dst: 謝天謝地，成功了……那裡就是我們的目的地，Eldritch Outlook。
A Journey Further#062.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#063.src: Now comes the hardest part... Come along. I'll need you there for it.
A Journey Further#063.dst: 最難的部分來了……跟我來。這一段我需要你在場。
A Journey Further#063.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#064.src: That blade there...it's made for sacrifice. See how that gate is shut?
A Journey Further#064.dst: 那邊那把劍……是用來獻祭的。看到那道門是關著的嗎？
A Journey Further#064.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#065.src: In order to open the doors to the Outlook, we need to sacrifice a powerful soul.
A Journey Further#065.dst: 要打開通往 Outlook 的門，我們得獻祭一個強大的靈魂。
A Journey Further#065.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#066.src: We... we should have told you from the start. You and Lucio. Elphie and I, we knew. We knew this would be here.
A Journey Further#066.dst: 我們……我們一開始就該告訴你的。你和 Lucio 都不知道。Elphie 和我知道。我們早就知道這裡有這個。
A Journey Further#066.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#067.src: We didn't have... we didn't have a sacrifice in mind. We decided that it would be best decided once we reached that point. And I think we both knew it would have to be one of us.
A Journey Further#067.dst: 我們沒有……我們心裡沒有預定的人選。我們說好等真的走到這一步再決定。而我想我們兩個都清楚，最後一定是我們其中一個。
A Journey Further#067.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#068.src: ...I think she would have insisted it be her. Even though both of us had something we would be le...
A Journey Further#068.dst: ……我想她會堅持由她來。即使我們兩個都還有放不下的……
A Journey Further#068.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#069.src: It doesn't matter now. It's just us left. And I've been mulling it over since we got to the town... you'll sacrifice me. I won't take no for an answer.
A Journey Further#069.dst: 現在說這些也沒意義了。只剩我們了。從進到那座鎮上開始我就一直在想這件事……由你來獻祭我。這件事我不接受拒絕。
A Journey Further#069.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#070.src: I mean... look at the state I'm in, {u}! I'm on death's door already, and you've proven yourself far stronger than I am even at my best.
A Journey Further#070.dst: 你看看我現在這副樣子，{u}！我已經站在鬼門關前了，而你早就證明自己遠比全盛時期的我還強。
A Journey Further#070.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#071.src: Here. You can take everything I had on me. My emeralds, and the key to the dungeon. I certainly won't be able to use them anymore.
A Journey Further#071.dst: 拿去。我身上的東西你全帶走。我的綠寶石，還有地城的鑰匙。反正我也用不到了。
A Journey Further#071.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#072.src: Upon the top of the tower is... Well, something. We don't know for certain what it is, but it will prevent you from passing through.
A Journey Further#072.dst: 塔頂上有……嗯，某個東西。我們不確定那究竟是什麼，但它會擋住你的去路。
A Journey Further#072.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#073.src: You'll have to kill it to break the barrier. But... find other soldiers who can help you. It will be impossible to defeat alone.
A Journey Further#073.dst: 你得殺了它才能破除屏障。不過……去找其他能幫你的士兵。一個人是打不贏的。
A Journey Further#073.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#074.src: ...no more putting it off, then. I'm bleeding out.
A Journey Further#074.dst: ……那就別再拖了。我血快流乾了。
A Journey Further#074.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#076.src: Right click to grab the blade in the altar.

A Journey Further#077.src: Now...strike me down. My soul will unlock the gate...
A Journey Further#077.dst: 現在……砍下來吧。我的靈魂會打開那道門……
A Journey Further#077.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#080.src: You...can do this. I know y-you can.
A Journey Further#080.dst: 你……做得到的。我知道你、你可以。
A Journey Further#080.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#082.dst: 那隻一直在看著我們的怪物……
A Journey Further#082.speaker: Aledar
